caption: The drawing depicts two main objects on a plain off-white background. The upper object is a round plate with a decorative rim colored in a reddish-brown shade with evenly spaced light dots, and the interior of the plate is mostly dark brown or black. On the plate, there is a symmetrical, stylized floral and leaf motif in shades of yellow, orange, and green. At the center of the plate's design, there is a heart shape outlined in yellow with the number "1624" inside it. Above and around the heart, branching stems extend upwards and outwards, ending in leaf and flower shapes. Below the plate, there is an elongated, shallow bowl or possibly a tray, shown in a side profile and colored in a dark reddish-brown. The artist’s signature "Aaron F. Forteney" appears in small script in the lower left corner.
title: Pa. German Plate
